summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: botocore/regions.py gets `import enum` and the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, enum.Enum) class with eleven members, values, and per-member comments. botocore/args.py gets the EPRBuiltins import (after botocore.endpoint, before botocore.signers), the optional endpoint_config parameter on _should_set_global_sts_endpoint (absent config treated as no variant tags), and compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults at the end of ClientArgsCreator. tests/unit/test_args.py gets TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with one test per behavioral criterion. Test results: tests/unit/test_args.py 59 passed; test_regions.py and test_client.py 356 passed. Not verified: black and flake8 are not installed in the shared venv, so formatting was checked only by line-length awk; the only over-79 line in the touched files (args.py:315) predates this change. Nothing committed.
